rawContent: For example, it says that #MeToo and #BLM  and movements like them often become "engines of political disintegration," framing this as an absolute negative and con of such movements.  But it never explores *why* they become such engines.

To get back to one of my arguments from the start of this thread, the reason that politics is becoming polarized, the reason that #BLM and #MeToo have become "engines of political disintegration" is not because we are meaner or nastier or more partisan than before.
